svg.title: Pairwise Synchronisation (Tang–Müller)
svg.desc: Left: curve i is matched to K partner curves; each pair gets a monotone piecewise-linear warp h_ik with two interior knots, fitted to the curves normalised by max|y|. Middle: the pairwise warps of curve i overlaid; partners whose fit cost exceeds the 0.9 quantile are dropped (dashed grey) and the rest are averaged (thick). Right: the average is the inverse warp; inverting it gives h_i, and the synchronised curves y_i(h_i(t)) share a common time scale without any template.
svg.text: No template: each curve’s warp is the inverse of the average of its pairwise warps
curve i, K partners, warp hᵢₖ per edge
fit ỹₖ∘hᵢₖ ≈ ỹᵢ, ỹ = y / max|y|
thick: mean of kept hᵢₖ = hᵢ⁻¹
K = round(subset_prop·(n−1)) partners · O(n·K) pairwise fits · no template
